subject: Executive briefing: compact demo + CIO attendance request
messages:
From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@novusgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive briefing: compact demo + CIO attendance request

Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time on last week's discovery call. We heard loud and clear that Amit (CIO) will want a high-level executive view focused on risk, integration risk, and ROI before committing budget. To make that efficient for all parties, can we propose a compact 45-minute executive briefing (VP/CIO/CTO-level) that covers:

- 15 min: strategic outcomes & fit (executive summary)
- 20 min: tailored demo highlights (integration + security facets)
- 10 min: outcomes, next steps, potential rollouts

We can follow with a separate technical deep-dive for the engineering team if that’s useful.

Proposed windows (US/PST):
- Wed Mar 17, 11:00–11:45am
- Thu Mar 18, 2:00–2:45pm

If Amit can confirm a preferred slot I’ll lock the calendar and include a 1‑page agenda. Attaching a draft agenda + short exec summary for your review.

Attachments: 2027-03-15_Redwood_Demo_Agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—Elliot

Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive briefing: compact demo + CIO attendance request

Elliot —

Thanks for the clear outline. Amit is traveling late Wednesday and prefers Thu 2:00–2:45pm PT if that slot is still available. A few notes from our side:

- Amit wants to be joined by our VP of Ops (briefly). If possible, keep the first 10 minutes very strategic.
- Procurement copied here needs a short deliverable post-demo listing hosting/data residency options and SLAs.
- We prefer a recording disabled by default; if you must record, please get explicit approval.

Can you confirm the 2pm PT slot and whether you can produce the SLA summary we mentioned?

Samira Khan
Head of Product Strategy, NovusGrid
samira@novusgrid.com | +1 (206) 555-4490

Quick internal note on cadence if we pivot to Thu 2:00pm PT: I agree a shorter exec-focused run (45 min) is cleaner given Amit’s travel. Two operational asks from our side before we confirm:

1) Can we prepare a one‑page SLA/residency summary called out for procurement? If Samira’s team needs it ahead of the session we should attach it to the calendar invite. I can draft a bulletized version.

Also: Hannah, can you check with Partnerships to see if the VP of Ops might want a quick pre-brief (10 minutes) right before the 2pm start? If yes we’ll include a 10-minute pre-brief buffer in the invite.
